methods.share: The Wilson score interval of the verified warnings in all the warnings, at the level of the file.
methods.overYears: The percentile bootstrap interval over the years: 10000 draws of the years with replacement, with a fixed seed for each measure.
methods.gate: The hull of the intervals of a measure and its value. A new value out of the gate interval of the committed file stops the workflow. A measure that a file does not have is 0 with the gate interval 0 to 0.
methods.noRead: The gate reads a share only when each year has 10 or more verified and 10 or more unverified warnings. Otherwise the gate gives no read for the share: not a pass and not a break.
methods.unverified: Cow links no storm report to some phenomena. The file keeps their counts with the reason and the evidence, and it has no share for them.
methods.cow: One request for each month, with one day of margin before and after the month. A warning counts in the month of its start. The id of a warning counts one time.
methods.ncei: The rows of each file of details, by EVENT_TYPE. The deaths and injuries of a type are the sums of the direct and indirect counts.
methods.under: For each alert kind and significance: the alerts of each year, and the NCEI events of the kind with harm under an active alert. An alert is one event number of one office in one VTEC year. A national number counts one time (national). An event is under an alert when an alert row of its county or zone is active from the begin of the event minus marginMs to its end. NCEI gives its own state codes to the territories and the waters, and the join reads them (NCEI_TERRITORIES, NCEI_WATERS). A water event meets only the rows of its marine zone. A county event meets only county rows, and a zone event meets only zone rows. The codes are the distinct UGC codes of the rows of each year. The gate does not read this section.
methods.windows: One request for each month, and one month before the first year. The service selects a row by its start, so two windows have no common row. An alert counts in the VTEC year of its number.

EW.label: Extreme Wind
EW.reason: Cow links no storm report to an extreme wind warning. Each EW warning is unverified by construction, not by measure.
sources: The Cow request ?begints=2024-09-26T00:00:00Z&endts=2024-09-28T00:00:00Z&phenomena=EW (sent on 2026-11-15): 6 EW warnings and 482 storm reports (SV 104, TO 61, FF 304, MA 11, DS 2). The stats have warned_reports 0 and events_verified 0. Each EW warning has an empty stormreports_all.
The measure of 2021 to 2025 (rates.yml, run 43751844753): 24 EW warnings, 0 verified.

The Cow page https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/cow/ (read on 2026-11-15), the parameter phenomena: "the currently supported Storm Based Warning types are Tornado (TO), Severe Thunderstorm (SV), Flash Flood (FF), Marine (MA), and Dust Storm (DS)." The list has no EW.

observed.text: Determined to have occurred or to be ongoing

marine.reason: The alerts of these phenomena name marine zones. NCEI keys a marine event by a code of its water, not by the letters of a marine UGC. Thus the join places no marine event, and the counts of these alerts give no rate.

national.TO.A: The Storm Prediction Center gives each watch a number for the whole country. Each office of the watch sends the watch with that number.
national.SV.A: The Storm Prediction Center gives each watch a number for the whole country. Each office of the watch sends the watch with that number.
national.HU: A tropical alert has the number of its storm from the hurricane center. Each office on the path of the storm sends that number.
national.TR: A tropical alert has the number of its storm from the hurricane center. Each office on the path of the storm sends that number.
national.SS: A storm surge alert has the number of its storm from the hurricane center. Each office on the path of the storm sends that number.
national.TY: A typhoon alert has the number of its storm from the typhoon center. Each office on the path of the storm sends that number.
